_comment: POSTURE C ON THE FIELD, ARM 2 — GPS + GALILEO, 20 min (40 ep).  Extends the
PASSED 10-ep GPS smoke (_pc305_tri_slant_10ep) with the three fixes from its
report and Galileo activated.  SAME-BUILD discipline: run the 44D7D965
snapshot exe (gnss_processor_fable_pc305.exe) so this arm is comparable to
the 10-ep record — do NOT rebuild mid-flight (concurrent session has the
trio-freeze work in the tree; it is default-OFF but same-build beats fresher).
STILL IGNITION: 40 epochs.  Level channels (vf, iono level, exchange,
consumer accuracy) remain BARRED (1 h rule).  Legal: wiring, datum
inventory, rank gate, pin audits, counters, same-window ratios vs the
10-ep arm.
THE FIXES (from the 10-ep report):
- serialize_sbasis_contract true: S contract line + cbpin= declaration
(golden305 promotion, absent from the agu chain — without it the product
declares no IF pin and a grader must refuse).
- trace_ionosphere false: kills the frame-broken diag rider (~1.9 s/ep of
selected-inverse in iono-diag; network_ionosphere.csv is x_r-only and
frame-broken per CLAUDE.md — nothing lost).
- trace_dd_fractional_epoch_stride 10: the dd-frac rider ran ~1.9 s/ep at
stride 1; 4 sampled epochs are plenty for a frac-only field instrument.
GALILEO ACTIVATION (the new variable):
- active_systems + explicit Galileo signal_priorities (standing trap: a
missing GPS/Galileo priorities entry silently emits an EMPTY product —
only GLONASS has a fail-loud guard).
- Families: pilot (C1C/C5Q/C7Q) + combined (C1X/C5X/C7X) on E1/E5a/E5b,
matching the GPS Q+X pattern the 10-ep arm validated (both families
admitted as network channels).  B/I data components deliberately NOT
whitelisted — every extra family is another per-sat channel-family
PB<->iono trade surface (the sbasis_complete recipe exists because of
exactly this class on GPS+Gal W6+SH).
- Galileo is the BEST posture-C constellation on paper: the whole fleet is
triple-frequency, so unlike GPS (15/32 dual-only, datum-only B records)
every E satellite should carry estimable modernized-DCB content.
PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATIONS:
1. Datum inventory grows to two constellations: per-sat IF + GF pins for
E, s2z levels for each admitted E signal; n_gf_only_pair for E ~0.
2. eq34 pin audit COMPLETE per (E, signal) chain, as for GPS.
3. E B-records: pinned pair ~datum-exact, remaining channels (X family +
third band) metre-scale content.
4. RISK — rank gate at default tolerance: GPS+Gal channel-family
near-nulls are DOCUMENTED on the W6+SH posture; whether the slant+GF
datum closes them is THE question this arm asks.  If withholds appear,
that IS the finding: report, do NOT arm sbasis_complete cold (rung-3
class: constrains the family at a garbage carried level).
5. S line present with cbpin= per constellation (unanimity permitting).
20 min at 30 s: max_duration_s 1171 covers t = 0..1170 = 40 epochs.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY — constellation set changes the state vector; never
resume from the 10-ep snapshot or any other.
